query: Make me a playlist containing three songs of Mariah Carey and name it 'Love Mariah'
code_without:
import requests

access_token = "YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
user_id = "YOUR_SPOTIFY_USER_ID"
song_uris = [
    "spotify:track:YOUR_MARIAH_CAREY_TRACK_ID_1",
    "spotify:track:YOUR_MARIAH_CAREY_TRACK_ID_2",
    "spotify:track:YOUR_MARIAH_CAREY_TRACK_ID_3",
]

headers = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.post(
    f"https://api.spotify.com/v1/users/{user_id}/playlists",
    headers=headers,
    json={"name": "Love Mariah", "public": False},
)
response.raise_for_status()
playlist_id = response.json()["id"]

response = requests.post(
    f"https://api.spotify.com/v1/playlists/{playlist_id}/tracks",
    headers=headers,
    json={"uris": song_uris},
)
response.raise_for_status()
code_with:
import requests

access_token = "YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"}
base_url = "https://api.spotify.com/v1"

# Get the current user's ID.
user_response = requests.get(f"{base_url}/me", headers=headers)
user_response.raise_for_status()
user_id = user_response.json()["id"]

# Create the playlist.
playlist_response = requests.post(
    f"{base_url}/users/{user_id}/playlists",
    headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"name": "Love Mariah", "public": True},
)
playlist_response.raise_for_status()
playlist_id = playlist_response.json()["id"]

# Add three Mariah Carey songs.
track_uris = [
    "spotify:track:0bRXwKfigvpKZUurwqAlEh",  # All I Want for Christmas Is You
    "spotify:track:4iLqG9SeJSnt0cSPICSjxv",  # We Belong Together
    "spotify:track:2aBxt229cbLDOvtL7Xbb9x",  # Always Be My Baby
]
add_response = requests.post(
    f"{base_url}/playlists/{playlist_id}/tracks",
    headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"uris": track_uris},
)
add_response.raise_for_status()
